title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
summary: A CISO is the senior leader accountable for an organisation's information and cyber security. They set the security strategy, run the security team and budget, lead response to major incidents, meet regulator rules from RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and CERT-In, and report cyber risk to the board. Indian regulators expect regulated firms to have one.
dailyDuties: Set the security strategy, roadmap and budget
Review the cyber risk register and approve risk treatment
Lead response to major incidents and report to CERT-In and regulators
Present cyber risk to the board and its risk committee
Handle regulator inspections and audit findings
Build and lead the security operations, engineering and GRC teams

skills.expectation: Set the security strategy and run the security programme
Own the cyber risk picture and decide which risks to treat
Meet RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and CERT-In cyber requirements and inspections
Set security architecture standards for cloud, identity and networks
Lead response to major cyber incidents and regulator reporting
Run the ISMS against ISO 27001 and NIST CSF
Brief the board and risk committee on cyber risk
Build and lead the security organisation
Work with the CTO, CRO, business heads and regulators
Oversee vendor and cloud security risk
Show cyber risk as likely loss
Work with the DPO on the DPDP Act
Plan and defend the security budget

certifications.why: Indian bank and insurer CISO adverts ask for CISSP.
Some adverts ask for CISA as well.
